files.content:
1: package llmverify
2: import chisel3._
3: import chisel3.util._
4: import chiselFv._
5: 
6: class swap(K: Int = 3, Nm1: Int = 7) extends Module with Formal {
7:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
8:     val i = Input(UInt(K.W))
9:     // Add outputs to preserve the entire design
10:     val x_out = Output(Vec(Nm1 + 1, UInt(K.W)))
11:     val tmp_out = Output(UInt(K.W))
12:     val p_out = Output(UInt(K.W))
13:     val m_out = Output(UInt(K.W))
14:   })
15:   
16:   // Register array x[0:Nm1]
17:   val x = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.tabulate(Nm1 + 1)(j => j.U(K.W))))
18:   
19:   // Temporary register
20:   val tmp = RegInit(0.U(K.W))
21:   
22:   // Wires for m and p
23:   val p = Wire(UInt(K.W))
24:   val m = Wire(UInt(K.W))
25:   
26:   // Combinational logic for p and m
27:   p := Mux(io.i >= Nm1.U, Nm1.U, io.i)
28:   m := Mux(p === 0.U, Nm1.U, (p - 1.U))
29:   
30:   // Sequential logic on positive clock edge
31:   when(true.B) { // Chisel implicitly uses the clock
32:     tmp := x(p)
33:     x(p) := x(m)
34:     x(m) := tmp
35:   }
36: 
37:   // ─── Formal Verification Assertions ───
38: 
39:   // Safety 1: p is always in bounds [0, Nm1]
40:   fvAssert(p <= Nm1.U, "p_in_bounds")
41: 
42:   // Safety 2: m is always in bounds [0, Nm1]
43:   fvAssert(m <= Nm1.U, "m_in_bounds")
44: 
45:   // Safety 3: p and m are distinct indices (swap must involve two different positions)
46:   fvAssert(p =/= m, "p_not_equal_m")
47: 
48:   // Safety 4: Cross-cycle swap correctness.
49:   // Capture the previous cycle's values to verify that x(p) gets the old x(m)
50:   // and x(m) gets the old x(p) after each update.
51:   val prev_x_p = RegNext(x(p))
52:   val prev_x_m = RegNext(x(m))
53:   val prev_p = RegNext(p)
54:   val prev_m = RegNext(m)
55: 
56:   // After the update, x(prev_p) should equal the old value of x(m)
57:   fvAssert(x(prev_p) === prev_x_m, "swap_x_p_gets_old_x_m")
58: 
59:   // After the update, x(prev_m) should equal the old value of x(p)
60:   fvAssert(x(prev_m) === prev_x_p, "swap_x_m_gets_old_x_p")
61: 
62:   // Connect outputs to preserve the design
63:   io.x_out := x
64:   io.tmp_out := tmp
65:   io.p_out := p
66:   io.m_out := m
67: }
68: 
69: object VerilogGenerator extends App {
70:   emitVerilog(new swap(), args)
71: }
